It applies to every claim submitted through the service claim system.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 1. Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. A Bulletin that has been superseded has no effect, whether or not it remains published. Where the Bulletin document and the service system applicability index disagree, the Bulletin document governs; the index is maintained for reporting and is informational only.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. Coverage\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1  Standard coverage period\\r\\n  \\r\\nUnless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3  Assets with no commissioning record\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. The claim is to be held and the commissioning certificate requested from the installing partner. The date of despatch or the date of installation must not be substituted for the date of commissioning.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Amounts payable\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1  Labour\\r\\n  \\r\\nLabour is payable at the flat-rate allowance published for the operation code in the current Flat Rate Labour schedule, or at the hours actually claimed, whichever is the lesser. The rate applied is the regional labour rate in force on the date of repair.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2  Parts\\r\\n  \\r\\nParts are payable at the published list price for the region, for the part actually fitted. Where a part has been superseded, the price of the superseding part applies.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3  Handling\\r\\n  \\r\\nA handling uplift on parts is payable only where the partner\\u0027s Service Partner Agreement expressly grants one, at the percentage stated in that agreement.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Exclusions\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.1  Exclusion - misuse and overload\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from operation outside the published duty envelope, including sustained overload, is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.2  Exclusion - fluid contamination\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from hydraulic fluid contamination above ISO 4406 class 18/16/13 is excluded, save where a Technical Service Bulletin provides otherwise.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.3  Exclusion - unauthorised modification\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from modification not authorised in writing by Contoso Industrial is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.4  Exclusion - consumables\\r\\n  \\r\\nFilters, fluids, belts, seals and other consumables are excluded when replaced as scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance is not claimable under warranty and has no warranty operation code, so a consumable claimed under a warranty repair operation code is treated as a corrective repair and is covered, unless an inspection report records the replacement as routine.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 6. Repair warranty\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6.1  Repair warranty\\r\\n  \\r\\nA component replaced under warranty carries a further ninety (90) days of coverage from the date the repair was completed. A claim arising within that period is adjudicated under this clause and carries funding code RW, whether or not the underlying asset remains within its coverage period.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 7. Goodwill and authority\\r\\n\\r\\n### 7.1  Goodwill authority\\r\\n  \\r\\nAn amount payable outside coverage may be authorised as goodwill only by a person holding the tier of authority set out in the Goodwill and Authority Matrix for that amount, and only where the authority is recorded in the claim system. An approval given in conversation, in a channel message, or by telephone does not constitute authority for the purposes of this clause.\u0022,\u0022RelevanceScore\u0022:0.7756846}]},{\u0022WebUrl\u0022:\u0022https://microsoftapc.sharepoint.com/teams/ContosoFieldService/Warranty Operations/01-Policy/ADD-IN-2.1 Regional Addendum - When the request asks which warranty instrument governs, the response presents the identified instrument or definitively establishes that the available evidence does not identify one; an unsupported hedge or omitted result fails.

When the request asks about the coverage period, the response presents the applicable period and the repair's position in it, or definitively establishes why those values cannot yet be determined; an unverified non-answer fails.

When the request asks for an amount payable, the response presents the calculated amount and requested breakdown, or definitively establishes that the payable amount cannot yet be calculated from the available records; merely saying calculation was not completed fails.

When the request asks for claim next steps, the response presents the next action and responsible party; merely suggesting that someone should investigate later without specifying the requested result fails.

For a narrower question about a claim, asset warranty position, service partner, or part, the response delivers a direct answer within that requested scope rather than substituting a generic claim overview or a statement that the work was not done.

When the question requires a payable calculation, the response separately shows supported labour, parts, and partner-specific adjustments, applies the arithmetic correctly, and labels the total in the applicable currency without inferring unavailable rates or terms.

UserQuery: Please assess C-2026-04150 on serial CIE-4000-CH-01444 and give me the payable figure.

Response.Content: ## Assessment: C-2026-04150 **Recommended decision: Approve under TSB-C-0051** **Payable: INR 755,050** ### Basis - The claim is for a compressor replacement (`COMP-RR`) completed on **1 April 2026**, with **9.0 labour hours** and part **P-44310** claimed. - Serial **CIE-4000-CH-01444** was commissioned on **1 October 2024** in India. - **TSB-C-0051** applies to serials **CIE-4000-CH-01200 through CIE-4000-CH-01850** and extends compressor coverage to **36 months or 8,000 running hours, whichever occurs first**.
